query:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO box_sets
             (namespace, value, plugin, name, overview, poster, backdrop, movies, looked_up)
         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8,
                 coalesce(?9, (SELECT looked_up FROM box_sets WHERE namespace = ?1 AND value = ?2),
                          '[]'))
